column1: # scripts/find_retrospective_cases.py over the citation graph of every verified
# design DOI in registry/. 220 rows, 202 distinct citing papers, 55 design papers.
# EVERY ROW IS A READING ASSIGNMENT, NOT A CASE. A case asserts what a paper
# REPORTED: the as-of date must be the paper's own, the expectation must come from
# its results rather than its abstract, and the assay must be the one the registry
# holds rather than a modified version of it. Four rows were read on 2026-10-26 and
# three of them failed one of those tests; see
# `groups` says which phrase family matched and so what kind of case a row could
# become: miss and mismatch could yield the scarce `fails` kind, weakened and
# redesign are indirect. `phrases` is the exact text matched in the abstract.
